name: marker

MARKER_BATCH_SIZE.description: Pages processed per batch. Defaults to 8. Lower if GPU memory is tight.

MARKER_DEVICE.description: Device for the OCR/layout models: 'cpu', 'cuda', or 'mps'. Defaults to autodetect.

OUTPUT_DIR.description: Directory to write extracted markdown + images into. Defaults to ./output.

notes: Local PDF→Markdown converter. EXECUTOR tier — pure read-of-input, write-to-OUTPUT_DIR with no shell or network. Bounded blast radius (filesystem only), so trust floor is low. License is GPL-3.0 — review before bundling into closed deployments.
